status_scope: Completeness of requested matrix; not semantic acceptance or formal Go

PRIOR.timestep_conversion: Cast scheduler timestep to model dtype, then divide by 1000, matching pipeline input
PRIOR.objective: Diagonal-covariance frozen-centered-feature MSE plus lambda_s*(a-1)^2 for each output channel
PRIOR.rho_definition: Square root of summed predicted centered Value residual variance divided by summed target variance; surrogate diagnostic only
PRIOR.schedule_contract: Reuse only with identical frozen fused weights, dtype, device, statistics and exact eight model timesteps; caller verifies scheduler
PRIOR.inference_cost: No extra token projection; eager per-token channel coefficient gathers add bandwidth and temporary memory
PRIOR.interpretation: Per-output-channel attention Value approximation; does not recover hidden drift, stale K or general cross-channel covariance; no quality claim
PRIOR.provenance_responsibility: Caller supplies and verifies source hashes, calibration-only data and image-level split
PRIOR.statistic_semantics: Target img_norm1 output before modulation; population variance, not post-modulation features
PRIOR.timestep_statistics_semantics: For pair (t,s), the same frozen h=mean_s+xi_s is used at both timesteps with diagonal Var(xi_s)=variance_s; anchor mean and variance only
